import os
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "..")))
os.environ["STAGE"] = "prod"
os.environ["DRY_RUN"] = "true"

from integrations.wms.logiwa.integration import PAGE_SIZE  # noqa: E402
from utils.boto import get_connections_row, get_org_private_key, org_decrypt  # noqa: E402
from utils.integrations import get_integration_file  # noqa: E402

CID = sys.argv[1]
row = get_connections_row(CID)
secret = org_decrypt(row["integration_secret"], get_org_private_key(row["org_id"]))
f = get_integration_file(row["integration_name"], row["integration_type"])
i = f.Integration(
    connection_id=CID,
    org_id=row["org_id"],
    integration_secret=secret,
    connection_additional_fields=row["additional_fields"],
    customer_id=row["customer_id"],
)


def walk(depositor_id):
    rows = []
    body = {"PageSize": PAGE_SIZE}
    if depositor_id:
        body["DepositorID"] = depositor_id
    page = 1
    started = time.time()
    while page:
        body["SelectedPageIndex"] = page
        response = i.logiwa_request("ListingInventoryReport", json=body, ignore_log=True)["Data"]
        rows.extend(response)
        if len(response) == PAGE_SIZE:
            page += 1
        else:
            pages = page
            page = None
    return rows, pages, time.time() - started


# same map-building as get_listing_inventory_and_active_map, so both sides are compared on output
def build_maps(rows):
    listing_inventory = {}
    product_active_map = {}
    for listing in rows:
        code = listing["Code"]
        if listing["ChannelID"] and not product_active_map.get(code):
            product_active_map[code] = listing["ChannelIsActive"] == True
        inv_id = f"{code}_{listing['DepositorID']}"
        if inv_id not in listing_inventory:
            listing_inventory[inv_id] = listing
    return listing_inventory, product_active_map


customers = i.get_warehouse_customers(None, None, False, True)["data"]
customer_ids = []
for customer in customers:
    customer_ids.append(customer["id"])
customer_ids.sort()
print(f"{CID}: {len(customer_ids)} warehouse customers", flush=True)

per_customer_rows = []
per_customer_pages = 0
per_customer_seconds = 0
for customer_id in customer_ids:
    rows, pages, seconds = walk(customer_id)
    print(f"  customer {customer_id}: {len(rows)} rows, {pages} pages, {seconds:.0f}s", flush=True)
    per_customer_rows.extend(rows)
    per_customer_pages += pages
    per_customer_seconds += seconds

unfiltered_rows, unfiltered_pages, unfiltered_seconds = walk(None)

unfiltered_inv, unfiltered_active = build_maps(unfiltered_rows)
per_customer_inv, per_customer_active = build_maps(per_customer_rows)

depositors_outside_customers = {}
for listing in unfiltered_rows:
    depositor = str(listing["DepositorID"])
    if depositor not in customer_ids:
        depositors_outside_customers[depositor] = depositors_outside_customers.get(depositor, 0) + 1

only_unfiltered = set(unfiltered_inv).difference(per_customer_inv)
only_per_customer = set(per_customer_inv).difference(unfiltered_inv)
active_diffs = []
for code in set(unfiltered_active).union(per_customer_active):
    if unfiltered_active.get(code) != per_customer_active.get(code):
        active_diffs.append(code)

print(f"RESULT {CID}")
print(f"  unfiltered:   {len(unfiltered_rows)} rows, {unfiltered_pages} pages, {unfiltered_seconds / 60:.1f} min")
print(f"  per customer: {len(per_customer_rows)} rows, {per_customer_pages} pages, {per_customer_seconds / 60:.1f} min")
print(f"  inventory keys: {len(unfiltered_inv)} unfiltered vs {len(per_customer_inv)} per customer")
print(f"  keys only in unfiltered: {len(only_unfiltered)} {sorted(only_unfiltered)[:10]}")
print(f"  keys only in per customer: {len(only_per_customer)} {sorted(only_per_customer)[:10]}")
print(f"  active map: {len(unfiltered_active)} vs {len(per_customer_active)}, {len(active_diffs)} differ {sorted(active_diffs)[:10]}")
print(f"  rows under a depositor that isn't a warehouse customer: {depositors_outside_customers}")

content.text:
Yes, it still slows down, and faster than the branch measured. The run was stopped at page 15 by Logiwa's rate limit, so I only have 14 pages:

| Page | Seconds |
|---|---|
| 1 | 6.6 |
| 3 | 15.9 |
| 5 | 27.3 |
| 7 | 51.0 |
| 9 | 62.1 |
| 11 | 74.7 |
| 14 | 81.0 |

Each page took about 5 seconds longer than the one before, and 14 pages took 10.6 minutes in total. The branch's commit had page 140 at 57.5 seconds; now page 14 already takes 81 seconds. If that climb continues, the full read of about 185 pages would take far longer than the 97 minutes the PR mentions.

On page 15, Logiwa returned rate-limit errors until the retries ran out (`ThrottleException: Logiwa rate limit exceeded`). The limit is per account, so the prod crawler for this connection was probably running at the same time and sharing the budget. That's the same way the PR says those crawls die.

So #5982 and #6075 haven't fixed this. 09023174 still needs the branch. If you want, I can also time the filtered read for its two warehouse customers on the same pages for a side-by-side, though it would hit the same rate limit if the crawler is running.
